config.label: Per-agent API key issued when you create the agent
config.description: Per-agent API key issued when you create the agent. Scopes every tool call to that agent's mailbox and outbound. Either AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY or AGENTICMAIL_MASTER_KEY must be set.

config.label: Master key for admin operations (creating agents, listing all accounts, deleting agents)
config.description: Master key for admin operations (creating agents, listing all accounts, deleting agents). Set this when the MCP client needs admin tools; otherwise prefer the per-agent AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY.

config.label: Base URL of the AgenticMail HTTP API
config.description: Base URL of the AgenticMail HTTP API. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3100 (the port the local CLI binds). Override when the API runs on a different host or port.
